what: The opening video plays through to the end on a background-color veil covering the hero — .2s after playback starts, the video and the Skip button turn on with a .3s ease, and when the video ends or Skip is pressed a circular hole opens at the veil’s center from 0 → 200% over .6s cubic-bezier(.7,.16,.27,.85), revealing the page below. When fully open the veil hides and fx:done fires.

options.reveal: Seconds until the video and Skip turn on after playback starts, default .2
options.max: Seconds before opening even if the video hasn’t ended, default 0 (wait until the end) — keep it short for screens opened often, like an app
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Panel holding the video (plays the video inside). If none, it opens right away
options.[data-fx-part=skip]: Button that opens right away on press (optional)

note: The overlay covers the screen with position: fixed. If autoplay is blocked (play() rejected) it opens right away without waiting. As in the original, the Skip button cell spans the full width (shifted by the right margin) and only the text sits at the right end.

from.where: index.html .rp-loader (original .js-loading — opening video 11.7s · Skip · circular hole .6s). In the full-site set, shared.js does the same job.
